title: Himachal Tourism Records High Inflow
message: Over 50,000 tourists visited Himachal Pradesh this weekend.
contentHtml:
Over 50,000 tourists visited Himachal Pradesh this weekend following fresh snowfall in Manali and Kufri.

Key Highlights

  • High hotel occupancy
  • Traffic advisories in place

title: Shimla Smart City Project Nears Completion
message: New pedestrian corridors opened for public in Shimla.
contentHtml: The administration has officially inaugurated new eco-friendly walkways in the Mall Road zone.
